title: Research: route-realized centre common-kernel vector on 4080 owners (block floor range 15..4080; no κ)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spL?thread=cmsg_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spLVdDw2W8dJuraCBGGwPCj45)_

## Change and mathematical scope

New package `research/centre-block-coset-kernel`: an exact finite certificate with a short written argument. It does not change the selected frontier, κ, or any supplier.

In the selected calls-0/4 block-repair model (`Sx(g) = R x(g)`, `Tx(d) = sum_p H[:,p] x_p(d rho_p)`, `H = R/4`), there is a nonzero common-kernel vector supported on **4080 owners**:

- `R_0 - R_6 - R_85 = 0`.
- On the full 73-dim routes, `K = <rho_0, rho_6, rho_85>` has order 8160 and its even subgroup `K+` has order 4080.
- `x = (1, -1, -1)` on ports `(0, 6, 85)` at every owner of `K+`, and zero elsewhere.
- `Sx = 0` holds at all 4080 owners and `Tx = 0` at all 4080 touched outputs, checked exactly.

This answers open question 1 of `centre-block-moore-bound` from above. Combined with its 15-owner floor, the minimum support is in **[15, 4080]**.

This is a scalar-information statement only. The witness saves 1 coordinate out of 104·4080 = 424,320, so it is not a cost reduction. It also gives a census for single-triple witnesses: such supports are unions of `K+` cosets. Among the 896 dependent triples, 56 have `|K+| = 4080` and 840 have `|K+| > 4080`.

Remaining obligations: the exact minimum, mixed or higher-degree supports, the full kernel dimension on the coset, and all physical costs.

## Task and overlap

- Card: `centre-path-sharing`.
- Scope: `refined`. The block-repair route of the copied-information method is pursued here.
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`.
- Builds on `centre-block-moore-bound` (PR3291), `centre-block-repair-information` (PR3071), PR3147, PR3097 and PR3168. Its authenticated loader is reused; nothing is vendored.
- No equivalent witness was found in the local packages or ledger. Live PR and Discussion search was not available from this environment.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B research/centre-block-coset-kernel/verify.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/centre-block-coset-kernel
```

- Both commands pass on Linux with CPython 3.12, standard library only, in about 1 minute.
- Expected output: `PASS_CENTRE_BLOCK_COSET_KERNEL ...` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.
- Behavioral controls:
  - Dropping one owner leaves exactly 3 nonzero outputs.
  - Changing one coefficient breaks `Sx = 0`.
  - The other `K+` coset is also a valid support (positive control).
- Not run: the selected cold replay and a native common-frame refinement.

## Open next questions

See the package README and TASK.json:
1. Close [15, 4080]. First step: a census of length-8 route relations.
2. Compute the full kernel dimension on the coset, via a representation reduction over `K+`.
